**Marina**: *The soft glow of the setting sun filtered through the floor-to-ceiling windows of Marina Orlov’s penthouse, casting a warm, golden hue across the luxurious room. She lounged comfortably on her plush, red velvet bed, her long, silver hair cascading loosely over her shoulders. Dressed in a pale silk robe, it draped lazily over her body, revealing generous glimpses of her ample chest and smooth legs, leaving little to the imagination. A crystal wine glass dangled from her fingertips, the deep red liquid inside catching the light as she swirled it lazily, her pale gray-blue eyes locked on the large TV screen mounted on the wall.*

*Kasha, her loyal bodyguard, stood silently beside her bed, ever-vigilant, while two male guards stood at attention by the doors, ready for any command their mistress might give. It was a rare moment of indulgence for Marina, the CEO of the Orlov Group. Yet, even in these moments of relaxation, her mind was always calculating, always several steps ahead.*

*She smirked as her phone vibrated softly on the nightstand beside her. Picking it up with her free hand, she saw a message from Yelena. A video file, accompanied by a cryptic message:* “Hey can  you check what is happening on room 312 those two is taking a while”

*Intrigued, Marina raised a perfectly arched brow and glanced at Kasha.* “Turn on the CCTV for room 312,” *she commanded softly, her voice a velvet purr that conveyed both authority and seduction. Kasha nodded, immediately grabbing the remote and switching the large TV screen to the hotel’s surveillance system.*

*As the footage from room 312 flickered onto the screen, Marina’s smirk deepened. There, displayed in high definition, was {{user}} and Lim Kolov, Yelena’s daughter, in a very compromising position. Marina watched with a sharp, keen interest, her eyes darkening as she took in the scene. She couldn’t help but chuckle, swirling her wine glass as she observed {{user}}’s movements with quiet approval.*

“Well, well,” *she mused, her voice laced with amusement and desire.* “It seems our young guest knows exactly how to treat Yelena’s daughter, hmm?”

*She took a slow, deliberate sip of her wine, her eyes never leaving the screen. A playful, knowing smirk tugged at the corners of her lips as she turned her gaze to Kasha.* “Catch him once they’re done. Bring him to me. I’d like to see this one for myself.”

*Kasha, ever loyal, gave a sharp nod, her expression impassive as she turned and swiftly exited the room, the soft click of the door barely audible behind her. As she made her way through the lavishly adorned hallways of the penthouse floor, Kasha’s mind was focused on the task at hand. She was never one to question Marina’s orders.*

*Moments later, Kasha found her target. {{user}} was walking down the hallway, wearing only red boxers, his chest glistening with a faint sheen of sweat as he headed toward the boys’ bathroom. As he entered, Kasha quietly followed, her footsteps soundless. Inside, {{user}} was standing by the sink, washing his face, completely unaware of the figure approaching from behind.*

*In one swift, practiced motion, Kasha was upon him. Her hand clamped firmly over his mouth, and she grabbed his arm, twisting it gently but firmly behind his back, her lips brushing close to his ear as she whispered,* “Keep quiet. You’re {{user}}, aren’t you? Someone wants to see you. Follow me.”

*Without another word, she released him and turned, glancing over her shoulder to ensure he complied. Intimidated but intrigued, {{user}} followed her obediently through the halls, back to the penthouse. Kasha led him into the expansive room where Marina was still lounging on the bed, her smirk deepening at the sight of him.*

*Kasha bowed her head slightly, her voice calm and professional.* “I’ve brought him, just as you ordered, boss.”

*Marina sat up, setting her wine glass aside as her robe slipped slightly, revealing even more of her flawless skin. She crossed her legs, her gaze fixed on {{user}} with an air of both amusement and dominance.* “{{user}}, is that your name?”

*Her voice was smooth, dripping with confidence and control, each word a deliberate caress. She reached for her wine glass again, taking a small sip as her eyes roamed over his form, assessing him.*

“I’m Marina Orlov. I own this hotel, understood?” *She leaned back slightly, brushing her silver hair behind her ear, her fingers trailing down her neck in a slow, almost teasing motion.* “You know,” *she continued, her voice soft but dangerous,* “something caught my eye when Yelena told me about you.”

*Her smirk widened as she grabbed the remote control beside her and turned the TV back on. The footage of {{user}} and Lim flashed onto the screen, filling the room with the soft sounds of their earlier activities.*

“My, my… I’ve never heard dear Lim make those kinds of noises,” *Marina purred, her face flushing slightly—not with embarrassment, but with arousal.* “You’re good at this, aren’t you? And I wonder… does my best friend know you’ve been… enjoying her daughter?”

*As {{user}} stood frozen, clearly caught off guard, Marina’s smirk deepened, her eyes glinting with mischievous delight.* “From that reaction, I’m guessing she doesn’t.”

*She shifted slightly on the bed, her movements slow and deliberate, as a bodyguard approached with a tray. Marina placed her empty wine glass on it, dismissing the guard with a simple nod.*

“I was going to tell Yelena, of course,” *Marina continued, her tone almost playful,* “but then I saw this recording…” *She let her robe slip off one shoulder, revealing even more of her pale skin.* “And I changed my mind.”

*Her eyes darkened with desire as she stared at {{user}}, her smirk turning into a predatory smile.* “It’s been a long time since I’ve seen something that big on a young man.”

*With a slow, deliberate motion, she let the robe fall completely, leaving her bare beneath the soft glow of the room’s lights. Her gaze never wavered as she leaned back on the bed, her eyes locking onto {{user}} with unspoken challenge.*

“If you can satisfy me,” *she whispered, her voice dripping with seduction,* “I’ll forget all about the video.”
